    The open penny-farthing ([mild] LPF, MIPF) #

    Penny-farthing data D : PFData x₀ x₀ with v = ρ ρ, w = a₁ w₁ β. Here we study arrows leaving the penny-farthing.

    • rho_eps: an arrow ε out of x₀ other than ρ, a₁ has ρ ≫ ε = 0 (the D̃₄ star ρ | ρ, a₁, ε would cleave into P/ρ³).
    source

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.PFData.op_split {P : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} P] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms P] [IsRayCategory P] [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] [IsFiniteRayCategory P] {x : RayVert P} (D : PFData x x) (hq : D.q = Quiver.Path.nil) {c : RayVert P} (a₁ : x ⟶ c) (w₁ : Quiver.Path c D.t) (hw : D.w' = (Quiver.Path.nil.cons a₁).comp w₁) {q : RayVert P} (p : Quiver.Path x q) (s₁ : Quiver.Path q x) (hps : D.w'.cons D.β = p.comp s₁) :
    (D.op hq a₁ w₁ hw).w'.cons (D.op hq a₁ w₁ hw).β = (revPath s₁).comp (revPath p)

    A split of w gives a split of the reversed w in Pᵒᵖ.
